title: Longest Palindromic Substring
description:
Given a string `s`, return the longest **palindromic substring** in `s`.

A substring is a contiguous non-empty sequence of characters within a string. Comparison is case-sensitive (`'A'` and `'a'` are distinct characters). If multiple palindromic substrings share the maximum length, you may return any one of them.
constraints: s consists only of English letters (lower-case and upper-case) and digits (0-9).
hints: Every palindrome mirrors around its center, which is either a single character (odd length) or a gap between two adjacent characters (even length).
Expanding outward from all 2n - 1 possible centers finds the longest palindrome in O(n^2) time and O(1) extra space.
To reach O(n) time, insert sentinel separators between characters and apply Manacher's algorithm to reuse previously computed palindrome radii via symmetry.

examples.explanation: "bab" is a longest palindromic substring of length 3; "aba" is also a valid answer.
"bb" is the unique longest palindromic substring of length 2.
The entire string "racecar" is itself a palindrome of length 7.
